declaredRowFilters.via: Package\Foreach Loop Container\Split File\Check If Contact Or Heir
declaredRowFilters.why: Only Rasham records with SUG_REC == "2" are written (output 'Heir Details' → Heir File Destination) to the heir file that this data flow re-reads; SUG_REC == "1" records go to the contact (deceased) file that is joined by 'Merge Join'; any other value goes to the unconnected Default output and is dropped

declaredRowFilters.via: Package\Foreach Loop Container\Create And Update Heir\Merge Join

declaredRowFilters.evidence: DTSX 6754-6756; Merge Join inputs DTSX 6762-6764 / 6779-6781; Sort key positions DTSX 6941/6947/6953, Sort 1 DTSX 7093/7099/7105

declaredRowFilters.evidence: conns DTSX 4-18, 49-63, 75-120, 121-135; Merge Join DTSX 6754-6756; Lookup DTSX 4070-4118

declaredRowFilters.via: Split File → files → Check If Contact Exist / Check If  Heir Exist / Heir source truncation
declaredRowFilters.why: Rasham 'Column 0' (positions 24+) is copied verbatim into both intermediate files: in the contact (SUG_REC=1) record its characters 9-17 are MIS_ZEHUT_MORISH, the key of routing Lookup 'Check If Contact Exist' (No Match → dropped to 'Derived Column 2'); in the heir (SUG_REC=2) record characters 1-9 are MIS_ZEHUT, key of 'Check If  Heir Exist' (Match → Update, No Match → this writer), and a heir record whose 'Column 0' is longer than 167 characters (SUG_PEULA = character 167 = position 190, MaximumWidth 1; trailing spaces count) truncates SUG_PEULA → row redirected and dropped (a normal 167-character record is kept)

crmWrites.condition: Per Foreach iteration with @[User::SelectedFilePath] != "": Rasham record SUG_REC == "2" (Split File) → re-read via [Source - Heir Details] (rows with truncation/conversion errors redirected and dropped) → INNER Merge Join with a SUG_REC == "1" contact record having the same MACHOZ/MIS_TIK/MIS_BAKASHA → 'Set Heir Columns' (gen_status/gen_name computation errors redirected to 'Derived Column 1'; gen_region cast error fails the component) → 'Check If Contact Exist' Match (a CRM contact with gen_identitynumber = zero-padded MIS_ZEHUT_MORISH; No Match → 'Derived Column 2' sink) → 'Check If  Heir Exist' No Match (no gen_heir with gen_identitynumber = padded MIS_ZEHUT AND gen_portfolionumber = MIS_TIK AND gen_requestnumber = MIS_BAKASHA AND gen_region = (DT_I4)MACHOZ; full cache). Rows whose entity build throws go to CastingError (unconnected).

notes: The real input file is [Source - Rasham] (@[User::SelectedFilePath]). Data flow 'Split File' copies its records to two intermediate RaggedRight files: SUG_REC == "2" → [Heir Details] (@[User::HeirDetailsFilePath]) and SUG_REC == "1" → [Contact Details] (@[User::ContactDetailsFilePath]), both Overwrite=true, no header. 'Create And Update Heir' re-reads them through [Source - Heir Details] / [Source - Contact Details] (same ConnectionString variables, set once from gen_etlvariable by 'Set Variables'). The re-read splits Rasham 'Column 0' (position 24 onward) into the detail fields by position. This file-to-file bridge is invisible to the deterministic lineage, so the Rasham fields are declared (declaredSources / declaredRowFilters) with the character offsets.
BUG (likely): Update Heir main.cs:162 tests Row.gencity_IsNull instead of Row.gencountry_IsNull — a changed country is updated only if the heir's city is not NULL.

Update Heir never updates gen_name (Create sets gen_name = first + " " + last), so a changed first/last name leaves gen_name stale; gen_region, gen_portfolionumber and gen_requestnumber are not updated either (they are lookup keys).
Update Heir gen_identitynumber assignment (main.cs:175-179) can never fire: it is compared with the value the full-cache lookup matched on.

Merge Join is INNER (JoinType=2): heirs whose request (MACHOZ+MIS_TIK+MIS_BAKASHA) has no SUG_REC=1 contact record in the same file are silently dropped; several contact records with the same three keys multiply the heir row (each copy is created/updated).

Heirs whose deceased (padded MIS_ZEHUT_MORISH) has no CRM contact go to 'Derived Column 2' (sink) — no gen_heir is created. The flat-file connections 'Contact Don't Exist', 'Convertion Failed Error' and 'Heir Load Failed Error' are not used by any component; all error/no-match outputs end in Derived Column sinks.

Lookups use full cache loaded before the rows flow: two identical heir rows (same id/portfolio/request/region) in one file both take the No Match path and create two gen_heir records. If several CRM contacts share gen_identitynumber, the lookup returns one of them (not deterministic from the DTSX).
gen_status: SUG_PEULA 'U' or 'C' → 1, any other non-NULL value → 2, NULL → NULL (not set on create). gen_name is NULL (not written) when either name is NULL.
Create Heir: Ok output column CreatedAccountId is never assigned (only OkBuffer.AddRow(), main.cs:219). Update compares dates as parsed.Date vs CRM value .AddHours(3).Date (fixed +3h offset).
